title: Treat answer generated as distinct from task complete
narrative: Fangore's pipeline produces an answer and still needs verification before the task is complete. When verification is required, generating text alone must not count as done; when verification passes, completion can proceed. Complements `fangore_bounded_repair_loop`. See inspiration requirements for verification as part of execution[^insp-verify].
implementation: `OutcomeContract` in `mechaharness.outcome_contract` distinguishes `answer_generated`, `verified`, `complete`, and `failed`. `DefaultVerificationPolicy` selects the strongest sufficient oracle and gates completion through the outcome contract when `require_verification` is set.
validation: Kind `verification_outcome_gate` → `_run_verification_outcome_gate`. Soft expects: answer without verification stays `answer_generated`; verification pass yields `complete`. Unit: `tests/test_inspiration_primitives.py`.
